'''New Coral City''' was the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] as of [[137 ABY]], and the seat of the [[Mon Calamari Council]]. Prior to the [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] takeover of the world in the aftermath of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the city was called '''Ackbarea'''. In 137 ABY, New Coral City became the site of the first [[Massacre of New Coral City|massacre]] in the [[Genocide on Dac|genocide]] of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] people ordered by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]].
